steps.content:
7:40 a.m., March 14, N.F.113
BR-004 Post-Disaster Contamination Cleanup Area

In the early morning, the air is slightly cool with some moisture. The disaster and strife are long gone, leaving the buzzing hovering drones. The Hypercube glows a blue light and silently purifies the residual contamination.
Half a year later, you come back to the <color=#fb9259>Keylan Square</color>.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The FAC decontamination force reports an unusual increase of residual contamination in the BR-004 lockdown area was observed two weeks ago.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The contamination level wasn't high, and the M-value in the area was maintained at a low level. But its source has yet to be located.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We need you to investigate...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Are there signs of the Black Ring being revived? Could there be remains of the "Corpus" you broke?
The Black Ring is rooted in the Corpus. It will burst when the Corpus revives and shatter when the "Corpseborne" is destroyed.
BR-004 can't be more dead. Its Corpus is inside you. Nothing can change that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There are traces of the ring left at the scene, but it can't be the original Corpus of BR-004. My shackles can't sense any sign of a "Corpus" around, either.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So either there's an unknown contamination mechanism, or the "thing" that caused the mutation has left.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood. I'll put together a report of your analysis immediately. Please leave the contaminated lockdown area and return to somewhere safe after the investigation finishes.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You don't have to enter the contamination zone yourself.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...You are not standing on safe grounds. The mental contamination field is weak but does exist, and FAC has found new Corruptors nearby.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Sinners aren't with you, are they?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I think I still have some fight in me.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes, your shackles are powerful. However, we know from the tests that the strength and controllability of the shackles are positively correlated with the level of contamination in your area.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: In an <color=#fb9259>intense mental contamination field</color>, they can be very powerful, and you have used them to solve many Mania crises and break two Black Rings.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But you are now in a purification zone where the M-value is maintained at a low level. Once you are not in a Mania-contaminated area, the shackles will remain inactive. If you force the Potestas, there will be severe consequences.
She's right. You showed incredible power with the inductive and destructive power of the shackles being pulled out to their extreme—in the Black Ring and highly distorted mental contamination fields.
Outside the Black Ring, you're the "loser" who depends on Sinners. The shackles may have a deep connection with the Black Ring and Mania, and you have more secrets that should be kept unknown.

Fortunately, everything happened in the isolated Mania zone, and you could hide the truth by crowning all the credits to Sinners. Hella has no doubt about it, and Hecate won't say anything. This is what you want.
...Too many people are watching you. It's safer and more convenient to disguise yourself as a weak but necessary loser than a scary "anomaly."

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, are you listening?
The adjutant sighs with a hint of pleading in her tone.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I know you take the Black Ring seriously, and we do need your intuition when it comes to the matter, but please take care of yourself.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The medical department has sent several warnings over the past month. You haven't fully recovered, and there has been an abnormal decline in your physical condition.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Black Ring is something that exceeds human perception. You keep fighting it and then return to where it used to be. Everyone is worried about the possible side effects it may have on you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: It's okay, Nightingale. I'll be back soon.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This place is more than a Black Ring, and I'd like to come back every now and then.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I see.
There is silence on the other end of the communicator, and you're grateful for her thoughtfulness. Your thought begins to drift to the past.
A ray of blue light falls to the ground.
It's a small Hypercube fragment, light, thin, and fragile like a snowflake.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did this fall out of a FAC decontamination device?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No, this is a Hypercube piece. It has just precipitated and has not yet formed a cube. Hypercubes come with the Black Ring, and there are various opinions on the reason.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Scientists speculate that when the ring becomes inactive, some areas within will slowly precipitate Hypercubes, just as reduced solubility will lead to supersaturated precipitation.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Hypercubes have been found at BR-004, and FAC is recovering these valuable resources. It's the only comfort people can get after the trauma.
The crystal piece lies quietly in the palm of your hand, and the shattered blue light brings you back to a corner of your chaotic memories.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It reminds me of old friends.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Of course. That's...
You hear an alarm on the other end of the communicator, interrupting the adjutant.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...There are Corruptors in the blockade area. There aren't too many, but they are close to the anti-Mania base.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is a clue delivered to our doorstep. Send me the coordinates, and I'll be on my way.
You put away all the sentimentality. Dwelling on the past is not what they would want for you, and those people deserve to be better remembered.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood. The Sinners will rendezvous with you immediately, and the FAC decontamination force is out too.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We aren't dealing with a large number of enemies. The only tricky part is the civilians on the scene. Those monsters are extremely hungry for human emotions. They could break through the anti-Mania base and cause more destruction.
